rougechain.body: A Layer 1 blockchain built around post-quantum cryptography — signatures, encryption and hashing use NIST-standardized algorithms.

xrge.body: Pays transaction fees (from 0.1 XRGE) and gas, and is staked to run validators (10,000 XRGE). Also trades as an ERC-20 on Base — bridge it to use natively.

security.title: Security
security.nist: RougeChain builds on these <hl>NIST-standardized</hl> algorithms. NIST standardizes the primitives — it has not reviewed or certified RougeChain itself.

networkUnknown.title: Network not confirmed

networkMismatch.title: Network mismatch — bridge disabled
networkMismatch.body: You're on the RougeChain {{network}} network, but this node's bridge reports {{chainLabel}} (chain {{chainId}}). A {{network}} network must not bridge {{assets}}, so bridging is disabled to protect your funds. This is a node misconfiguration — its bridge chainId/token must match the {{network}} Base chain.

advanced.title: Advanced: deposit with OP_RETURN
advanced.intro: For power users, or to recover a manual deposit already sent with an OP_RETURN binding.
advanced.step1: Send BTC to the custody address
advanced.step2: Add an OP_RETURN with your RougeChain address
advanced.step2Help: In the same transaction, paste this into your wallet's OP_RETURN / memo / data field. It binds the deposit to your wallet — without it the funds can't be credited.
advanced.opReturnWallets: OP_RETURN is supported by wallets like Sparrow, Electrum, BlueWallet (advanced) and bitcoinjs. Custodial apps (Coinbase, Cash App) usually can't attach one — use an OP_RETURN-capable wallet for this deposit.
advanced.step3: Paste the Bitcoin txid to claim qBTC
advanced.claimHelp: Verification waits for Bitcoin confirmations, so this can take a while. Claiming is idempotent — safe to re-paste the same txid later.

claim.title: Claim an existing deposit
claim.help: Sent ETH or USDC to the bridge but it didn't arrive? Paste the Base transaction hash to claim it — mints to your connected RougeChain wallet. Waits for confirmations automatically.

buy.title: Buy XRGE on Base
buy.subtitle: XRGE is the ERC-20 token of RougeChain on Base mainnet. Swap ETH, USDC or tokens from other chains for XRGE right here; the route is priced through the Aerodrome pool. To move XRGE onto RougeChain afterwards, use the bridge.
buy.contractNote: Always check the address before you buy. There is only one XRGE. Verify on
buy.step1: Connect a wallet that supports Base (Coinbase Wallet, MetaMask, Rabby…).
buy.step2: Choose what you pay with. ETH on Base is cheapest; other chains and tokens are routed automatically.
buy.step3: Review the quote and confirm in your wallet. You receive XRGE on Base.
buy.step4: Optional: bridge XRGE to RougeChain to stake, trade on the on-chain DEX or use the apps.
buy.disclaimer: Swaps execute in your own wallet through a third-party router; RougeChain never holds your funds or keys. Prices move with the pool; check slippage before confirming. This is not investment advice.

welcome.title: Welcome to RougeChain
welcome.body: A post-quantum wallet, DEX, messenger and mail in one place. Your keys, chats and mail are protected with quantum-resistant cryptography (ML-DSA-65 + ML-KEM-768). Here's a quick tour.

wallet.title: Wallet
wallet.body: Send and receive XRGE and tokens, create your own token, and shield funds for privacy. Tap the eye icon to hide balances.

swap.title: Swap & pools
swap.body: Trade tokens on the built-in DEX and provide liquidity to earn fees. Check the price impact before you confirm.

messenger.title: Messenger
messenger.body: End-to-end encrypted chats. Send photos, payments and payment requests, react to and reply to messages, and start group chats.

mail.title: Mail
mail.body: Encrypted mail with your own name@rouge.quant address — name@qwalla.mail works too. Claim your name in Settings, then compose, reply and forward.

nfts.title: NFTs
nfts.body: Browse collections, mint your own, and use any NFT you own as your profile photo.

bridge.title: Bridge
bridge.body: Move ETH, USDC and XRGE between Base and RougeChain as qETH, qUSDC and XRGE.

security.title: Locked & private
security.body: Protect your wallet with a password and auto-lock in Settings. Your private keys never leave this browser.

backup.title: Back up — don't lose your messages
backup.body:
Two things keep you safe, and they are different:

• Recovery phrase restores your wallet and funds — but NOT your chat history.
• Encrypted backup file (.pqcbackup) restores your wallet, funds AND your messages.

Export a backup in Settings → Security & backup and keep both somewhere safe.
